sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: When Dennis Nilsen moved out of his flat at 195 Melrose Avenue in Cricklewood, he had already taken the lives of 12 victiMs.
sentences.zh: 当丹尼斯·尼尔森搬出他位于克里克伍德梅尔罗斯大道195号的公寓时，他已经夺走了12名受害者的生命。

sentences.en: By Monday, November 23, 1981, he had been living in his new flat at 23 Cranley Gardens in Muswell
sentences.zh: 到1981年11月23日星期一，他已经在马斯韦尔山克兰利花园23号的新公寓里

sentences.en: Hill for seven weeks and was eager to put the past behind him and start afresh.
sentences.zh: 住了七个星期，他渴望将过去抛在脑后，重新开始。

sentences.en: It was his
sentences.zh: 那天是他的

sentences.en: 36th birthday and to celebrate he took the day off work and headed out to the pub.
sentences.zh: 36岁生日，为了庆祝，他请了一天假，去了酒吧。

sentences.en: As his new home was only five miles from his old address, he continued to frequent many of his usual drinking haunts.
sentences.zh: 由于他的新家距离旧址只有五英里，他继续频繁光顾他常去的那些饮酒场所。

sentences.en: At 1.30pm, Nilsen was drinking in the Golden Lion pub on Dean Street in Soho when he struck up a conversation with Paul Nobbs, a 19-year-old undergrad who was studying Slavonic
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分，尼尔森正在苏活区迪恩街的“金狮”酒吧喝酒，这时他与保罗·诺布斯搭上了话，保罗是一名19岁的本科生，在伦敦大学学习斯拉夫

sentences.en: and Eastern European studies at the University of London.
sentences.zh: 和东欧研究。

sentences.en: Paul was supposed to be attending a lecture but had decided to take the afternoon off to buy some books.
sentences.zh: 保罗本该去听讲座，但决定下午请假去买些书。

sentences.en: Nilsen was impressed by Paul's intelligence and the two chatted for an hour until Paul announced that he needed to go to the bookstore.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森对保罗的才智印象深刻，两人聊了一个小时，直到保罗说他需要去书店。

sentences.en: Nielsen accompanied him there and invited Paul back to his flat for dinner afterwards.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森陪他去了那里，并邀请保罗之后回他的公寓吃晚饭。

sentences.en: Paul accepted the invitation and they stopped at a nearby supermarket to purchase some chops and liquor, arriving back at 23 Cranley Gardens at around 5.45pm.
sentences.zh: 保罗接受了邀请，他们在附近的超市停下来买了些排骨和酒，大约下午5点45分回到克兰利花园23号。

sentences.en: The three-storey residence was once a single family home, but had since been split into a multi-tenant building.
sentences.zh: 这座三层住宅曾经是一个单户家庭住宅，但后来被分割成了一栋多租户建筑。

sentences.en: Its owner didn't live on site, instead hiring the services of local real estate agency Ellis & Co.
sentences.zh: 房主不住在这里，而是聘请了当地的房地产中介公司Ellis & Co.

sentences.en: to manage the property and its tenants.
sentences.zh: 来管理该房产及其租户。

sentences.en: In addition to Dennis Nielsen, there were four other tenants living in the building.
sentences.zh: 除了丹尼斯·尼尔森外，楼里还住着其他四名租户。

sentences.en: The ground floor was divided into two flats, one of which was occupied by a builder named Jim Alcock and his bartender girlfriend Fiona Bridges.
sentences.zh: 底层被隔成了两间公寓，其中一间住着一位名叫吉姆·奥尔科克的建筑工人和他的调酒师女友菲奥娜·布里奇斯。

sentences.en: The other was leased to two young women, a dental nurse from New Zealand named Vivian McStay and a youth worker from Holland named Monique Van Rutter.
sentences.zh: 另一间租给了两名年轻女性，一位是来自新西兰的牙科护士薇薇安·麦克斯泰，另一位是来自荷兰的青年工作者莫妮克·范·鲁特。

sentences.en: The first floor was unoccupied.
sentences.zh: 二楼无人居住。

sentences.en: Nilsen lived on the top floor, in a small, squalid attic space that was accessed via two flights of stairs.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森住在顶楼，那是一个狭小、肮脏的阁楼空间，需要爬两段楼梯才能到达。

sentences.en: Its front door opened to a small, grimy hallway that served as a kitchen, with a small cupboard,
sentences.zh: 前门通向一个狭小、污秽的走廊，走廊兼作厨房，左侧有一个小橱柜、

sentences.en: gas stove, and sink to the left, as well as a door that led directly to a grubby bathroom.
sentences.zh: 燃气灶和水槽，还有一扇直接通往肮脏浴室的门。

sentences.en: To the right of the hallway were two doors, one that opened onto a living room containing
sentences.zh: 走廊右侧有两扇门，一扇通往客厅，里面有

sentences.en: wardrobes, two armchairs and a tea chest, and another that led to Nielsen's disorganised bedroom.
sentences.zh: 衣柜、两把扶手椅和一个茶箱，另一扇通往尼尔森杂乱的卧室。

sentences.en: A double bed sat in the middle of the room, with a small sofa to its right, along with a television, stereo, several pot plants, and other rods and ends.
sentences.zh: 房间中央放着一张双人床，右侧有一张小沙发，还有一台电视、音响、几盆盆栽以及其他零碎物品。

sentences.en: Each room had sloping ceilings and dull brown carpets that were simply laid on top of the floor instead of fitted into place.
sentences.zh: 每个房间都有倾斜的天花板和暗棕色的地毯，地毯只是简单地铺在地上，而不是固定好的。

sentences.en: When Nilsen and Paul Nobbs arrived at the flat, Nilsen cooked them dinner and the two sat down to drink and watch television.
sentences.zh: 当尼尔森和保罗·诺布斯到达公寓时，尼尔森为他们做了晚饭，两人坐下来喝酒看电视。

sentences.en: Paul called his mother to let her know he'd be home shortly, but he then started feeling sick from all the alcohol
sentences.zh: 保罗给母亲打了电话，告诉她他很快就会回家，但他随后因为喝了太多酒而感到恶心，

sentences.en: and phoned her back to say he would be spending the night at a friend's place.
sentences.zh: 又打电话告诉她，他今晚要在朋友家过夜。

sentences.en: The two men eventually undressed, hopped into Nilsen's bed and started kissing, but they were both tired and soon fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 两人最终脱了衣服，钻进尼尔森的床上开始亲吻，但他们都累了，很快就睡着了。

sentences.en: At 2am, Paul woke up feeling nauseated with a throbbing headache.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点，保罗醒来，感到恶心，头痛欲裂。

sentences.en: He went to the kitchen, poured himself a glass of water and sat on the couch for a while.
sentences.zh: 他走到厨房，给自己倒了一杯水，在沙发上坐了一会儿。

sentences.en: Nilsen got up to check on him and they both went back to bed.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森起身查看他的情况，两人随后又回到床上睡觉。

sentences.en: At 6am, Paul woke again and went back to the kitchen, which had a mirror above the sink.
sentences.zh: 早上6点，保罗再次醒来，回到厨房，厨房水槽上方有一面镜子。

sentences.en: Upon catching a glimpse of his reflection, Paul realised that his face was red and bruised and his eyes were bloodshot.
sentences.zh: 当看到自己的倒影时，保罗意识到他的脸又红又肿，眼睛布满血丝。

sentences.en: His hands were shaking uncontrollably, his throat hurt and there was a deep red mark across his neck.
sentences.zh: 他的双手无法控制地颤抖，喉咙疼痛，脖子上有一道深红色的印记。

sentences.en: When Nilsen saw Paul, he remarked, God, you look awful, and suggested that he see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 当尼尔森看到保罗时，他评论道：“天哪，你看起来糟透了”，并建议他去看医生。

sentences.en: He then wrote down his address and told Paul that he hoped they would see one another again.
sentences.zh: 随后他写下了自己的地址，告诉保罗他希望他们能再见面。

sentences.en: Paul staggered away from Nilsen's flat and made his way to the University of London for his scheduled classes.
sentences.zh: 保罗摇摇晃晃地离开了尼尔森的公寓，前往伦敦大学上预定的课程。

sentences.en: One of his tutors noticed that he looked incredibly unwell and immediately booked him an appointment at the University College Hospital around the corner from the campus.
sentences.zh: 他的一位导师注意到他看起来非常不舒服，立即为他在校园拐角处的大学学院医院预约了就诊。

sentences.en: At the clinic, Paul's hands shook so badly that he knocked over a cup of coffee and was unable to light a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 在诊所，保罗的手抖得太厉害，以至于打翻了一杯咖啡，也没法点燃香烟。

sentences.en: The doctor gave him a tranquiliser to calm his nerves and after conducting a check-up, deemed that Paul's symptoms were consistent with having been strangled.
sentences.zh: 医生给了他一种镇静剂来平复神经，在进行检查后，认为保罗的症状与被勒过一致。

sentences.en: Although Paul Knobbs realised that Dennis Nilsen must have attacked him in his sleep
sentences.zh: 尽管保罗·诺布斯意识到丹尼斯·尼尔森一定是在他睡着时袭击了他，

sentences.en: and then acted as though nothing had ever happened, he decided not to report the incident to the police.
sentences.zh: 而且事后表现得好像什么都没发生过一样，但他决定不向警方报告这起事件。

sentences.en: To explain the mark that remained visible across his neck for the next three months, he told others that he had been attacked during a mugging.
sentences.zh: 为了解释脖子上在接下来的三个月里一直清晰可见的印记，他告诉别人他是在一次抢劫中遭到袭击的。

sentences.en: Paul spotted Nilsen at the Golden Lion about a year after the incident, but avoided speaking to him.
sentences.zh: 事件发生约一年后，保罗在“金狮”酒吧看到了尼尔森，但避开了他，没有说话。

sentences.en: In March 1982, four months after the attack on Paul Nobbs, Nilsen was drinking at the Salisbury on St Martin's Lane, London's
sentences.zh: 1982年3月，在袭击保罗·诺布斯四个月后，尼尔森正在圣马丁巷的“索尔兹伯里”酒吧喝酒，这是伦敦

sentences.en: preeminent gay bar, when he ran into 28-year-old John Howlett, whom Nilsen knew as John the Guardsman.
sentences.zh: 最著名的同性恋酒吧，这时他遇到了28岁的约翰·豪利特，尼尔森称他为“卫兵约翰”。

sentences.en: The two had met at another pub a couple of months earlier, where John had boasted of being an ex-Grenadier guardsman, and they had chatted over drinks for a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 两人几个月前在另一家酒吧见过面，当时约翰吹嘘自己曾是掷弹兵卫队队员，他们边喝边聊了几个小时。

sentences.en: John had lived a troubled life.
sentences.zh: 约翰的生活很坎坷。

sentences.en: At the age of 13, he was kicked out of his family home and spent his adolescence living in group residences, where he was constantly in trouble with the police.
sentences.zh: 13岁时，他被赶出家门，青少年时期都在集体宿舍度过，在那里他经常惹上警察。

sentences.en: As an adult, John had served time in prison for theft and made ends meet by working in travelling fairgrounds.
sentences.zh: 成年后，约翰因盗窃罪入狱，靠在流动游乐场工作维持生计。

sentences.en: At the Salisbury, John recognised Nilsen and joined him for a drink at the bar.
sentences.zh: 在“索尔兹伯里”酒吧，约翰认出了尼尔森，并加入他一起在吧台喝酒。

sentences.en: The service was slow, which frustrated Nilsen, and he suggested they go to his flat to drink instead.
sentences.zh: 服务很慢，这让尼尔森感到沮丧，他建议他们去他的公寓喝酒。

sentences.en: John agreed, and the pair walked to a liquor store to stock up on alcohol before catching the tube back to 23 Cranley Gardens.
sentences.zh: 约翰同意了，两人步行到一家酒类商店买了酒，然后乘地铁回到克兰利花园23号。

sentences.en: There, Nilsen cooked dinner and the two settled in to drink and watch television in the living room.
sentences.zh: 在那里，尼尔森做了晚饭，两人在客厅里安顿下来喝酒看电视。

sentences.en: As midnight approached, John asked if he could rest his head for a while.
sentences.zh: 午夜临近时，约翰问他是否可以休息一会儿。

sentences.en: Nilsen agreed and continued watching TV while John left to lie down in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森同意了，继续看电视，而约翰去卧室躺下。

sentences.en: At around 1am, Nilsen went to the bedroom and found John lying half-naked and asleep in his bed.
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点左右，尼尔森走进卧室，发现约翰半裸着睡在他的床上。

sentences.en: He woke him and commented,
sentences.zh: 他叫醒了他，评论道：

sentences.en: I thought you were getting your head down.
sentences.zh: “我以为你要休息一下。”

sentences.en: I didn't know you were moving in.
sentences.zh: “我不知道你要搬进来住。”

sentences.en: Nilsen offered to call John a taxi, but John said he didn't feel like getting up.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森提出帮约翰叫出租车，但约翰说他不想起床。

sentences.en: This frustrated Nilsen as he didn't find John attractive and no longer wanted him in his flat
sentences.zh: 这让尼尔森感到沮丧，因为他觉得约翰没有吸引力，不想再让他待在自己的公寓里。

sentences.en: He poured himself another glass of rum and sat on the edge of the bed
sentences.zh: 他给自己又倒了一杯朗姆酒，坐在床边，

sentences.en: Contemplating what to do next
sentences.zh: 思考着下一步该做什么。

sentences.en: Eventually, Nilsen retrieved a strap of material from underneath an armchair
sentences.zh: 最终，尼尔森从扶手椅下拿出一根带子，

sentences.en: Straddled John's body and tied the material around his neck
sentences.zh: 跨在约翰身上，把带子系在他的脖子上，

sentences.en: Remarking
sentences.zh: 并说道：

sentences.en: It's about time you went.
sentences.zh: “你该走了。”

sentences.en: A furious struggle ensued, during which Nilsen struck John's head against the edge of the headrest, drawing blood.
sentences.zh: 一场激烈的挣扎随之发生，期间尼尔森将约翰的头撞向床头边缘，导致流血。

sentences.en: John continued to fight back, but soon fell off the bed and lost consciousness.
sentences.zh: 约翰继续反抗，但很快从床上摔了下来，失去了知觉。

sentences.en: Nilsen tightened the material around John's neck until he was sure he was dead.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森勒紧约翰脖子上的带子，直到确定他已经死了。

sentences.en: Nilsen's dog Bleep was barking frantically in the next room, so he went to comfort her.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的狗“哔哔”在隔壁房间狂吠，于是他去安慰它。

sentences.en: When he returned to the bedroom a few minutes later, he discovered that John was still breathing.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，当他回到卧室时，发现约翰还有呼吸。

sentences.en: Nilsen strangled him again, then dragged him into the bathroom, filled the tub with water, and held John's head down until he was no longer breathing.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森再次勒死他，然后把他拖进浴室，在浴缸里放满水，按住约翰的头，直到他不再呼吸。

sentences.en: Nilsen left him there as he changed the sheets on his bed and then went to sleep with bleep curled up by his feet.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森把他留在那里，换了床单，然后带着蜷缩在脚边的“哔哔”睡着了。

sentences.en: The following morning, Nilsen hid John's body in his wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，尼尔森把约翰的尸体藏在衣柜里。

sentences.en: Three days later, he covered his bathroom floor with garbage bags, retrieved the body, and began dismembering it.
sentences.zh: 三天后，他用垃圾袋铺满浴室地板，取出尸体，开始肢解。

sentences.en: To dispose of the organs, he cut them into pieces and flushed them down the toilet.
sentences.zh: 为了处理内脏，他把它们切成小块，冲进了马桶。

sentences.en: This proved to be a time consuming process, so he attempted to speed things up by boiling the flesh and organs into a soup-like consistency that was easier to flush.
sentences.zh: 事实证明这是一个耗时的过程，所以他试图通过把肉和内脏煮成汤状来加快速度，这样更容易冲走。

sentences.en: Once the bones of the hands, feet and ribs were free of flesh, he broke them apart and placed them in his regular rubbish bin to be tossed out with the rest of his household waste.
sentences.zh: 一旦手、脚和肋骨的骨头没有了肉，他就把它们弄碎，放进普通的垃圾桶里，和其他生活垃圾一起扔掉。

sentences.en: Nilsen packed the bigger bones, including the skull, arms, legs and pelvis into several garbage bags along with salt and padding and stored them in
sentences.zh: 尼尔森把较大的骨头，包括头骨、手臂、腿和骨盆，装进几个垃圾袋，连同盐和填充物一起存放在

sentences.en: the tea chest in the corner of his living room.
sentences.zh: 客厅角落的茶箱里。

sentences.en: Two months later, in May 1982, Nilsen was drinking at a gay bar in Camden called the Black Cap when he noticed a young blonde man drinking alone.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，即1982年5月，尼尔森在卡姆登一家名为“黑帽”的同性恋酒吧喝酒时，注意到一个金发年轻男子独自喝酒。

sentences.en: The man had several red marks on his face and Nilsen approached to ask about his injuries.
sentences.zh: 那个男人的脸上有多处红印，尼尔森走过去询问他的伤势。

sentences.en: The man introduced himself as 21-year-old Carl Stodder and explained that he had just escaped from an abusive boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 那人自我介绍说是21岁的卡尔·斯托德，并解释说他刚从一个虐待他的男朋友那里逃出来。

sentences.en: His facial wounds were carpet burns from the most recent attack and he was drinking to distract himself.
sentences.zh: 他脸上的伤是最近一次袭击留下的地毯擦伤，他喝酒是为了分散注意力。

sentences.en: Nilsson smiled and reassured Carl that he was still attractive despite his injuries.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森微笑着安慰卡尔，说他尽管受了伤，依然很有魅力。

sentences.en: Carl was struck by Nilsson's kindness and the two began chatting, bonding over the shared alienation they felt from their families.
sentences.zh: 卡尔被尼尔森的善意所打动，两人开始聊天，因对家庭的疏离感而产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: When the black cap closed, Nilsen invited Carl back to his flat.
sentences.zh: 当“黑帽”酒吧关门时，尼尔森邀请卡尔回他的公寓。

sentences.en: He accepted and they caught a cab holding hands throughout the ride.
sentences.zh: 他接受了，他们在乘车过程中一直手牵着手。

sentences.en: Nilsen didn't approve of the route the driver chose to take them home and became unusually angry, retaliating by paying with the smallest change possible.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森对司机选择的回家路线不满意，变得异常愤怒，并以支付尽可能小的零钱作为报复。

sentences.en: Once they arrived at 23 Cranley Gardens, the two men drank heavily while listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达克兰利花园23号后，两人一边听音乐一边狂饮。

sentences.en: At one point, Nilsen insisted Carl listen to his favourite song using headphones and stood behind him as he did so, watching intently.
sentences.zh: 有一次，尼尔森坚持让卡尔戴上耳机听他最喜欢的歌，并站在他身后，专注地看着他。

sentences.en: They became affectionate, but Carl told Nilsen he didn't feel like having sex.
sentences.zh: 他们变得亲昵起来，但卡尔告诉尼尔森他不想发生性关系。

sentences.en: Carl eventually had too much to drink and felt ill, so they decided to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 卡尔最终喝得太多，感到不舒服，于是他们决定上床睡觉。

sentences.en: Nilsen pointed out that the sleeping bag on his bed had a loose zipper and warned
sentences.zh: 尼尔森指出他床上的睡袋拉链松了，并警告

sentences.en: Carl to be careful not to get caught in it.
sentences.zh: 卡尔小心不要被拉链夹住。

sentences.en: About an hour later, Carl woke up suddenly when he felt a sharp pain and sense of tightness around his neck.
sentences.zh: 大约一小时后，卡尔突然醒来，感到一阵剧痛，脖子周围有一种紧绷感。

sentences.en: Nilsen was behind him, pulling on the sleeping bag, warning Carl to stay still.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森在他身后，拉着睡袋，警告卡尔保持不动。

sentences.en: Thinking he was caught in the zipper and that Nilsen was trying to help him out, Carl struggled to set himself free, but soon lost consciousness.
sentences.zh: 卡尔以为自己被拉链夹住了，尼尔森是在帮他脱身，于是挣扎着想要解脱，但很快失去了知觉。

sentences.en: When he came to, he could hear water running and felt incredibly cold.
sentences.zh: 当他醒来时，他能听到流水声，感到非常冷。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: I knew I was in the water and he was trying to drown me.
sentences.zh: “我知道我在水里，他想淹死我。”

sentences.en: He kept pushing me into the water.
sentences.zh: “他一直把我往水里按。”

sentences.en: The third time I came up, I said, no more, please, no more.
sentences.zh: “第三次我浮上来时，我说，不要了，求你，不要了。”

sentences.en: And he pushed me under again.
sentences.zh: “他又把我按了下去。”

sentences.en: I just thought I was dying.
sentences.zh: “我当时以为我要死了。”

sentences.en: I thought this man was killing me and I was dying.
sentences.zh: “我以为这个人在杀我，我要死了。”

sentences.en: I thought, you are drowning.
sentences.zh: “我想，你要溺水了。”

sentences.en: This is what it feels like to die.
sentences.zh: “这就是死亡的感觉。”

sentences.en: I felt very relaxed and I passed out.
sentences.zh: “我感到非常放松，然后就昏过去了。”

sentences.en: I couldn't fight anymore.
sentences.zh: “我再也无法反抗了。”

sentences.en: Assuming that Carl was now dead,
sentences.zh: 以为卡尔已经死了，

sentences.en: Nilsen carried him out of the bath and placed him on the living room floor.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森把他从浴缸里抱出来，放在客厅的地板上。

sentences.en: His dog Bleep then started licking Carl's face, which alerted Nilsen to the fact that he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 他的狗“哔哔”开始舔卡尔的脸，这让尼尔森意识到他还活着。

sentences.en: Seemingly changing his mind about murdering Carl, he spent the next few hours attempting to revive him and warming him up.
sentences.zh: 他似乎改变了谋杀卡尔的主意，花了接下来的几个小时试图救活他并为他取暖。

sentences.en: Carl eventually regained consciousness, but was dazed and disorientated and had trouble remembering what had happened.
sentences.zh: 卡尔最终恢复了知觉，但神志不清，方向感全无，很难记起发生了什么。

sentences.en: He saw his reflection and realised there was a deep red mark around his neck and broken blood vessels all over his face and in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他看到自己的倒影，意识到脖子上有一道深红色的印记，脸上和眼睛里布满了破裂的血管。

sentences.en: Nilsen explained that Carl had been caught in a sleeping bag zipper and lost consciousness and that he had splashed water onto Carl's face to wake him up.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森解释说卡尔被睡袋拉链夹住昏了过去，他往卡尔脸上泼水是为了叫醒他。

sentences.en: In a state of shock, Carl believed Nilsen, who spent the morning comforting him.
sentences.zh: 处于震惊状态的卡尔相信了尼尔森，尼尔森整个上午都在安慰他。

sentences.en: When Carl started to feel slightly better, Nilsen walked him to a nearby tube station and gave him his name and address in case he wanted to remain in contact.
sentences.zh: 当卡尔感觉好一点时，尼尔森陪他走到附近的地铁站，并给了他自己的名字和地址，以防他想保持联系。

sentences.en: Carl made his way to the Royal Free Hospital in Hampstead, roughly three miles from Nilsen's flat and told a doctor there that he'd been caught in a zipper.
sentences.zh: 卡尔前往距离尼尔森公寓约三英里的汉普斯特德皇家自由医院，并告诉那里的医生他被拉链夹住了。

sentences.en: The doctor was adamant that Carl's injuries were consistent with having been strangled and concluded that someone may have tried to kill him.
sentences.zh: 医生坚称卡尔的伤势与被勒过一致，并断定可能有人试图杀他。

sentences.en: But Carl, still in a state of shock, was uncertain what to believe.
sentences.zh: 但卡尔仍处于震惊状态，不确定该相信什么。

sentences.en: Around the time of the attack on Karl Stodder, Nilsen applied for another promotion at the job centre but was once again denied.
sentences.zh: 在袭击卡尔·斯托德前后，尼尔森在就业中心申请了另一次晋升，但再次被拒绝。

sentences.en: He wrote a letter to his personnel manager saying that he felt victimised and asked what was preventing him from moving up the ladder.
sentences.zh: 他写信给人事经理，说他感到受了迫害，并询问是什么阻碍了他升职。

sentences.en: Nilsen was subsequently invited to appeal the decision and succeeded.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森随后被邀请对该决定提出上诉，并获得了成功。

sentences.en: After eight years of service, he was finally promoted to the role of Executive Officer
sentences.zh: 在工作八年后，他终于被提升为执行官。

sentences.en: On June 28 1982, Nilsen was reassigned to the Kentish Town Job Centre branch
sentences.zh: 1982年6月28日，尼尔森被调往肯蒂什镇就业中心分部，

sentences.en: Located approximately three and a half miles from his flat in Muswell Hill
sentences.zh: 距离他在马斯韦尔山的公寓大约三英里半。

sentences.en: His manager was a woman named Janet Lehman and the two formed a close professional relationship that was the happiest of Nilsen's working career.
sentences.zh: 他的经理是一位名叫珍妮特·莱曼的女士，两人建立了密切的职业关系，这是尼尔森职业生涯中最快乐的时光。

sentences.en: Despite these positive changes, he continued to drink heavily and within a couple of months, he resumed his old patterns.
sentences.zh: 尽管有了这些积极的变化，他还是继续酗酒，几个月内，他又恢复了旧习。

sentences.en: One September evening, Nilsen returned to his flat with 27-year-old Graham Allen.
sentences.zh: 九月的一个晚上，尼尔森带着27岁的格雷厄姆·艾伦回到了他的公寓。

sentences.en: Graham was a Scottish-born heroin addict with a troubled past who had moved to London in 1971 under the false lure of easy employment.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆是一名苏格兰裔海洛因成瘾者，有着坎坷的过去，他于1971年在轻松就业的虚假诱惑下搬到了伦敦。

sentences.en: Since then, he had spent years squatting in abandoned buildings, funding his drug addiction through a mix of government unemployment benefits, panhandling, and petty theft.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他多年来一直非法居住在废弃建筑中，靠政府失业救济金、乞讨和轻微盗窃来维持毒瘾。

sentences.en: Throughout the late 1970s and early 80s, he spent time in both rehab and prison, and when released, he escalated to robbing pharmacies.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代末和80年代初，他曾多次进出康复中心和监狱，获释后，他开始抢劫药店。

sentences.en: Graham was engaged in a long-running affair with a woman named Leslie who was the girlfriend of a well-known local criminal and the two had a young son together.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆与一名叫莱斯利的女子有着长期的恋情，她是当地一位知名罪犯的女友，两人还有一个年幼的儿子。

sentences.en: One night in September 1982,
sentences.zh: 1982年9月的一个晚上，

sentences.en: Graham and Leslie had a frenzied argument.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆和莱斯利发生了激烈的争吵。

sentences.en: Graham was drunk and demanded that Leslie give him money to buy heroin.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆当时喝醉了，要求莱斯利给他钱去买海洛因。

sentences.en: When she refused, he proceeded to punch himself in the face.
sentences.zh: 当她拒绝时，他开始猛击自己的脸。

sentences.en: Fearful of his increasingly violent behaviour, Leslie locked Graham out of her house, telling him to go away and never come back.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利对他日益暴力的行为感到恐惧，于是把格雷厄姆关在门外，让他离开，永远不要再回来。

sentences.en: It's unclear where Graham and Nilsen met or how Graham ended up at Nilsen's flat, but once they were there, Graham requested something to eat.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚格雷厄姆和尼尔森是如何认识的，也不清楚格雷厄姆是如何来到尼尔森公寓的，但他们到那儿后，格雷厄姆要求吃点东西。

sentences.en: Nilsen didn't have much food in the house except for a carton of eggs, so he made Graham a large omelette.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森家里没多少吃的，只有一盒鸡蛋，于是他给格雷厄姆做了一个大煎蛋卷。

sentences.en: When Graham was about three quarters of the way through eating it, he suddenly fell asleep or passed out with a large piece of the omelette hanging out of his mouth.
sentences.zh: 当格雷厄姆吃到四分之三的时候，他突然睡着了或昏了过去，一大块煎蛋卷还挂在嘴边。

sentences.en: Nilsson couldn't tell whether Graham was still breathing or not, but he leaned forward and proceeded to strangle him.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森无法判断格雷厄姆是否还有呼吸，但他俯下身，开始勒他的脖子。

sentences.en: He later recalled,
sentences.zh: 他后来回忆道：

sentences.en: If the omelette killed him, I don't know, but anyway, in going forward, I intended to kill him.
sentences.zh: 如果是煎蛋卷杀了他，我不知道，但无论如何，在那一刻，我确实打算杀了他。

sentences.en: An omelette doesn't leave red marks on her neck.
sentences.zh: 煎蛋卷可不会在脖子上留下红印。

sentences.en: I suppose it must have been me.
sentences.zh: 我想那一定是我干的。

sentences.en: The next day, Nilsen filled the bathtub with water and placed Graham's body inside it before going to work as usual.
sentences.zh: 第二天，尼尔森往浴缸里注满水，把格雷厄姆的尸体放进去，然后像往常一样去上班了。

sentences.en: He kept the body in the tub for three days, changing the bathwater on occasion.
sentences.zh: 他把尸体留在浴缸里三天，偶尔会换换洗澡水。

sentences.en: On the fourth day, he dismembered Graham's body, boiled several of the body parts, and then flushed the organs and some of the flesh down the toilet.
sentences.zh: 第四天，他肢解了格雷厄姆的尸体，煮了几个身体部位，然后把内脏和一些肉冲进了马桶。

sentences.en: He placed the rest of the remains into black plastic bags and stuffed them into the tea chest alongside the remains of
sentences.zh: 他把剩下的残骸装进黑色塑料袋，塞进茶箱里，和

sentences.en: John Howlett.
sentences.zh: 约翰·豪利特的残骸放在一起。

sentences.en: Graham's girlfriend Leslie was used to him disappearing for long periods of time, but he always wrote her letters during his absence.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆的女友莱斯利习惯了他长时间失踪，但他不在的时候总是会给她写信。

sentences.en: After she failed to hear from him for several months, Leslie continued to hope that Graham was alive, but feared that he had actually passed away from an overdose.
sentences.zh: 在几个月没收到他的消息后，莱斯利依然希望格雷厄姆还活着，但又担心他其实已经因吸毒过量而去世了。

sentences.en: He was never reported missing.
sentences.zh: 他从未被报失踪。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday December 22, 1982, Nilsen was drinking in a Soho pub when he met 20-year-old Trevor Simpson,
sentences.zh: 1982年12月22日星期三，尼尔森在苏活区的一家酒吧喝酒时，遇到了20岁的特雷弗·辛普森，

sentences.en: who had just been released from prison after serving a six-month sentence for carjacking.
sentences.zh: 他因劫车罪服刑六个月，刚从监狱释放出来。

sentences.en: The two began talking and after a few drinks, Nilsen invited Trevor back to his flat.
sentences.zh: 两人开始交谈，喝了几杯酒后，尼尔森邀请特雷弗回他的公寓。

sentences.en: Trevor accepted and the two went to 23 Cranley Gardens, where Nilsen told Trevor he was welcome to sleep in one of the armchairs in his living room.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗接受了，两人去了克兰利花园23号，尼尔森告诉特雷弗，他可以睡在客厅的扶手椅上。

sentences.en: The next morning, he extended the offer and Trevor stayed for several more days.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他再次提出邀请，特雷弗又多住了几天。

sentences.en: Although he was happy to have a place to stay over Christmas, Trevor soon became frustrated with Nilsen, who continuously bombarded him with left-wing political rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 虽然特雷弗很高兴能在圣诞节期间有个住处，但他很快对尼尔森感到厌烦，因为尼尔森不断地向他灌输左翼政治言论。

sentences.en: He also noticed an awful odour that seemed to emanate from the flat, but wasn't inclined to search for the source of the smell.
sentences.zh: 他还注意到公寓里似乎散发着一股难闻的气味，但并没有去寻找气味的来源。

sentences.en: By Monday December 27, Trevor had stayed at the flat for five days.
sentences.zh: 到了12月27日星期一，特雷弗已经在公寓里住了五天。

sentences.en: Nilsen made them a stew to eat but became irritated when Trevor made a rude remark about the taste.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森给他们做了炖菜吃，但当特雷弗对味道发表了粗鲁的评论时，他变得很恼火。

sentences.en: Later that night, Nilsen drunkenly muttered something about needing to consult with the professor about whether or not Trevor could stay any longer.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，尼尔森醉醺醺地嘟囔着说，需要和教授商量一下特雷弗是否还能继续住下去。

sentences.en: Trevor went to bed shortly afterwards but awoke at 1am to find the living room filled with smoke.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗不久后就上床睡觉了，但在凌晨1点醒来时，发现客厅里烟雾弥漫。

sentences.en: He ran to the kitchen, where he found Nilsen calmly drinking a glass of water.
sentences.zh: 他跑到厨房，发现尼尔森正平静地喝着一杯水。

sentences.en: The smoke was determined to be coming from a pair of jeans on the living room floor, which Nilsen said was likely caused by Trevor dropping a lit cigarette.
sentences.zh: 烟雾被确定来自客厅地板上的一条牛仔裤，尼尔森说这很可能是特雷弗掉落的烟头引起的。

sentences.en: The fire was extinguished without further incident and Trevor stayed for one more night before moving on, with Nilsen saying he was welcome to return, any time.
sentences.zh: 火被扑灭了，没有发生其他意外，特雷弗又住了一晚才离开，尼尔森说欢迎他随时回来。

sentences.en: A few days later, at around lunchtime on Friday December 31, Nilsen visited a pub down the street from his flat.
sentences.zh: 几天后，12月31日星期五午餐时间左右，尼尔森去了他公寓楼下的一家酒吧。

sentences.en: He returned home at 8pm and knocked on the door of his downstairs neighbours,
sentences.zh: 他晚上8点回到家，敲了楼下邻居的门，

sentences.en: Vivian McStay and Monique Van Rutter, to ask if they wanted to watch television with him upstairs.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安·麦克斯泰和莫妮克·范·鲁特，问她们想不想上楼和他一起看电视。

sentences.en: The women declined as they were in the middle of cooking dinner and could also tell that Nilsen was very drunk.
sentences.zh: 两位女士拒绝了，因为她们正在做晚饭，而且也能看出尼尔森喝得烂醉。

sentences.en: He seemed annoyed by their refusal but invited them to join him at the local pub later that night to celebrate the new year, then went back upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他对她们的拒绝似乎感到恼火，但还是邀请她们当晚晚些时候去当地酒吧一起庆祝新年，然后就回楼上了。

sentences.en: At around 11pm, Nilsen walked to the nearby Green Man pub where he met a young Japanese chef named Toshimitsu Ozawa.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点左右，尼尔森走到附近的“绿人”酒吧，在那里遇到了一个名叫小泽俊光的年轻日本厨师。

sentences.en: The pub closed just after midnight and the two decided to return to Nilsen's flat.
sentences.zh: 酒吧午夜刚过就关门了，两人决定回到尼尔森的公寓。

sentences.en: Once they were inside, Nilsen calmly approached Toshimitsu with a necktie pulled tautly between
sentences.zh: 进屋后，尼尔森平静地走向小泽，手里拿着一条领带，紧紧地拉在

sentences.en: his outstretched arMs. At first, Toshimitsu thought Nilsen was joking, but when Nilsen repeated the action again, Toshimitsu realised Nilsen was serious.
sentences.zh: 他伸出的双臂之间。起初，小泽以为尼尔森在开玩笑，但当尼尔森再次重复这个动作时，小泽意识到尼尔森是认真的。

sentences.en: Terrified, Toshimitsu kicked
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的小泽踢了

sentences.en: Nilsen in the groin and fled from the flat, running down the stairs and into the night.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的腹股沟，然后逃离了公寓，跑下楼梯，消失在夜色中。

sentences.en: The downstairs neighbours, Vivian and Monique, heard arguing, followed by banging and the sound of someone sobbing.
sentences.zh: 楼下的邻居薇薇安和莫妮克听到了争吵声，接着是撞击声和某人的啜泣声。

sentences.en: They ventured outside to see what was going on, only to find a highly intoxicated Nilsen on the stairs.
sentences.zh: 她们冒险出去查看发生了什么事，结果发现一个醉得不省人事的尼尔森在楼梯上。

sentences.en: Toshimitsu reported the incident to police, but felt it was too much trouble to follow through with the complaint and subsequently withdrew it.
sentences.zh: 小泽向警方报告了这起事件，但觉得后续投诉太麻烦，随后撤回了投诉。

sentences.en: Less than four weeks later, on Wednesday January 26, 1983, Nilsen was walking through London's
sentences.zh: 不到四周后，1983年1月26日星期三，尼尔森走在伦敦的

sentences.en: West End when he started chatting with a 20-year-old named Stephen Sinclair.
sentences.zh: 西区时，开始与一个名叫斯蒂芬·辛克莱的20岁年轻人聊天。

sentences.en: Stephen, who had been born in Scotland and was adopted, had lived a hard life.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬出生在苏格兰，是个被领养的孩子，生活过得很艰辛。

sentences.en: Throughout his childhood, he struggled with severe personality problems, was afflicted by regular bedwetting and often self-harmed.
sentences.zh: 童年时期，他一直饱受严重人格问题的困扰，经常尿床，还经常自残。

sentences.en: At the age of 12, he was diagnosed with psychomotor epilepsy, a disorder that impacts the brain's temporal lobe and impairs an individual's awareness to their surroundings.
sentences.zh: 12岁时，他被诊断出患有精神运动性癫痫，这是一种影响大脑颞叶并损害个人对周围环境认知的疾病。

sentences.en: Stephen was subsequently institutionalised and placed into foster care, and by the time he was 18, he was addicted to amphetamines and had contracted hepatitis B.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬随后被送进收容所并被寄养，到18岁时，他已经对安非他命上瘾，并感染了乙型肝炎。

sentences.en: He moved to London where he lived in hostels or squatted in derelict houses and spent most of his time loitering around Leicester Square.
sentences.zh: 他搬到伦敦，住在旅舍或废弃的房子里，大部分时间都在莱斯特广场附近游荡。

sentences.en: He was well known to social workers and police in the area and had been imprisoned multiple times.

sentences.zh: 彼得·杰伊带领的多名警官抵达了克兰利花园23号。

sentences.en: The police conducted a further search of the drain and retrieved several more pieces of flesh, each approximately 4 inches long and 1
sentences.zh: 警方对下水道进行了进一步搜查，又找回了几块肉，每块大约4英寸长、1

sentences.en: inch wide, along with three small bones with a knuckle at each end.
sentences.zh: 英寸宽，还有三块两端带有指关节的小骨头。

sentences.en: DCIJ personally took the remains to Charing Cross Hospital for examination by David Bowen, a professor of forensic medicine
sentences.zh: 杰伊总督察亲自将这些遗骸送到查令十字医院，由伦敦大学法医学教授、

sentences.en: at the University of London, who also worked as a consultant pathologiSt. Professor Bowen declared
sentences.zh: 同时担任顾问病理学家的戴维·鲍恩进行检查。鲍恩教授断定

sentences.en: that the small bones and knuckle had come from the hand of a human male and that the flesh was human neck tissue.
sentences.zh: 这些小骨头和指关节来自一名成年男性的手，而那些肉是人类的颈部组织。

sentences.en: The flesh also displayed a clear ligature mark, leading Professor Bowen to conclude that the victim had been strangled.
sentences.zh: 肉块上还有明显的勒痕，这让鲍恩教授得出结论：受害者是被勒死的。

sentences.en: As Nilsson's workday drew to an end, he tried to behave normally, but he knew an arrest was imminent and he would likely never return to the office again.
sentences.zh: 随着尼尔森的工作日接近尾声，他试图表现得正常，但他知道逮捕迫在眉睫，他可能再也回不到办公室了。

sentences.en: Before he left, he wrote a note urging his colleagues not to believe any reports that might emerge claiming he had taken his own life in jail.
sentences.zh: 离开前，他写了一张字条，恳求同事们不要相信任何关于他在狱中自杀的报道。

sentences.en: He tucked the note inside a drawer, tidied his desk, and said a cheerful goodbye to his workmates.
sentences.zh: 他把字条塞进抽屉，整理好办公桌，并愉快地与同事们道别。

sentences.en: Some noticed he was wearing a blue and white football scarf, which was out of character as he typically wore drab, dark clothing.
sentences.zh: 有人注意到他戴着一条蓝白相间的足球围巾，这与他平时的风格不符，因为他通常穿暗沉的深色衣服。

sentences.en: It would later be revealed that the scarf had belonged to his last victim, Stephen Sinclair.
sentences.zh: 后来证实，这条围巾属于他的最后一名受害者斯蒂芬·辛克莱。

sentences.en: At 5.40pm, Nilsen arrived home to find three detectives, Detective Chief Inspector Peter Jay, Detective Inspector Stephen McCusker,
sentences.zh: 下午5点40分，尼尔森回到家，发现三名侦探——侦探总督察彼得·杰伊、侦探督察斯蒂芬·麦卡斯克

sentences.en: and Detective Constable Jeffrey Butler, waiting at the front door of the building.
sentences.zh: 和侦探警员杰弗里·巴特勒——正在大楼前门等候。

sentences.en: DCI Jay introduced himself and explained that they were there to investigate the items found in the blocked drains.
sentences.zh: 杰伊总督察做了自我介绍，并解释说他们是来调查在堵塞的排水管中发现的物品。

sentences.en: Nilsen feigned surprise and asked if the other two detectives were health inspectors.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森假装惊讶，问另外两名侦探是不是卫生检查员。

sentences.en: DCIJ explained that they were all police officers and wanted to ask him some questions.
sentences.zh: 杰伊总督察解释说他们都是警察，想问他一些问题。

sentences.en: Nilsen led the three men upstairs to his flat and once they were inside, DCIJ revealed that some of the objects in the drain had been identified as human remains.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森带着三人上楼回到公寓。进屋后，杰伊总督察透露，排水管里的一些物体已被确认为人类遗骸。

sentences.en: He then asked Nilsen,
sentences.zh: 随后他问尼尔森：

sentences.en: Where's the rest of the body?
sentences.zh: 尸体的其余部分在哪里？

sentences.en: Without hesitation, Nilsen calmly replied,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森毫不犹豫，冷静地回答：

sentences.en: In two plastic bags in the wardrobe next door.
sentences.zh: 在隔壁衣柜里的两个塑料袋里。

sentences.en: I'll show you.
sentences.zh: 我带你们去看。

sentences.en: He led the officers into the living room and handed over the keys to unlock the wardrobe, saying he wanted to tell them everything.
sentences.zh: 他带着警官们走进客厅，交出了打开衣柜的钥匙，说他想把一切都告诉他们。

sentences.en: DCIJ read Nilsen his rights then placed him under arrest on suspicion of murder, although they still had no idea who the victim was.
sentences.zh: 杰伊总督察宣读了尼尔森的权利，并以谋杀嫌疑将其逮捕，尽管他们当时还不知道受害者是谁。

sentences.en: They led Nilsen to the police car and as they drove towards Hornsey Police Station, one of the officers asked Nilsen whether they were dealing with one body or two.
sentences.zh: 他们将尼尔森带上警车。在前往霍恩西警察局的路上，一名警官问尼尔森他们处理的是一具还是两具尸体。

sentences.en: He replied, 15 or 16 since 1978, I'll tell you everything.
sentences.zh: 他回答说：1978年以来有15或16具，我会告诉你们一切。

sentences.en: It's a relief to get it off my mind.
sentences.zh: 说出来让我轻松多了。

sentences.en: Nilsson initially declined to hire a lawyer and was held in custody while the police conducted a thorough search of his flat, recovering the
sentences.zh: 尼尔森起初拒绝聘请律师，在警方对他公寓进行彻底搜查期间被拘留，搜出了

sentences.en: remains of John Howlett and Graham Allen from the tea chest and Stephen Sinclair from the drawer in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 约翰·豪利特和格雷厄姆·艾伦在茶箱里的遗骸，以及斯蒂芬·辛克莱在浴室抽屉里的遗骸。

sentences.en: Two days later, at 10.45am on Friday February 11, the police conducted their first official interview with Nilsen.
sentences.zh: 两天后，即2月11日星期五上午10点45分，警方对尼尔森进行了第一次正式审讯。

sentences.en: He admitted to the murders of the three men whose remains were found at 23 Cranley Gardens and to a further 12 at his former residence on Melrose Avenue in
sentences.zh: 他承认谋杀了在克兰利花园23号发现遗骸的三名男子，以及他在克里克伍德梅尔罗斯大道旧居处的另外12名受害者。

sentences.en: Cricklewood.
sentences.zh: 克里克伍德。

sentences.en: Police took Nilsen to the Melrose Avenue flat, where he showed them the two locations in the rear garden and surrounding wasteland where he had burned the bodies of his
sentences.zh: 警方将尼尔森带到梅尔罗斯大道的公寓，他向他们展示了后花园和周围荒地中他焚烧其他受害者尸体的两个地点。

sentences.en: other victiMs. He also confessed to as many as seven other attempted murders.
sentences.zh: 他还供认了多达七起其他谋杀未遂案件。

sentences.en: Police had a difficult task ahead of trying to formally identify the victiMs. Nilsen remembered few of
sentences.zh: 警方在正式确认受害者身份方面面临艰巨的任务。尼尔森几乎记不起

sentences.en: their names and couldn't recall enough specific details about each individual to provide an immediate identification.
sentences.zh: 他们的名字，也无法回忆起每个人的具体细节以供立即辨认。

sentences.en: As it was 1983, DNA testing didn't yet exist and CCTV technology was still in its infancy, so the police had to rely on fingerprints, dental records and the
sentences.zh: 由于当时是1983年，DNA检测尚未问世，闭路电视技术也处于起步阶段，所以警方不得不依赖指纹、牙科记录和

sentences.en: victim's personal iteMs. This meant that they also had no choice but to depend on the assistance of Dennis Nilsen himself.
sentences.zh: 受害者的个人物品。这意味着他们别无选择，只能依赖丹尼斯·尼尔森本人的协助。

sentences.en: Stephen Sinclair was the first to be identified.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·辛克莱是第一个被确认身份的。

sentences.en: At the time of his death, the 20-year-old was wanted by police for some minor offences and his fingerprints were already on file.
sentences.zh: 他去世时，这名20岁的年轻人因一些轻微罪行被警方通缉，他的指纹已经在案。

sentences.en: Forensic investigators found fingerprints on Stephen's leather jacket, a used syringe and a
sentences.zh: 法医调查人员在斯蒂芬的皮夹克、一支用过的注射器和一只

sentences.en: tobacco tin, all of which were found in Nilsen's flat, and tested them against the prints on file to confirm a match.
sentences.zh: 烟草罐上发现了指纹，这些物品都在尼尔森的公寓里找到，经与存档指纹比对，确认相符。

sentences.en: At 5.45pm on February 11, Nilsen was officially charged with Stephen's murder.
sentences.zh: 2月11日下午5点45分，尼尔森被正式指控谋杀斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: Under further advice from law enforcement, Nilsen retained the services of Ronald Moss, a middle-aged solicitor who had experience dealing with lower-profile murder cases.
sentences.zh: 在执法部门的进一步建议下，尼尔森聘请了罗纳德·莫斯，一位在中低调谋杀案方面有经验的中年律师。

sentences.en: During their first meeting, Nilsen took an immediate liking to Moss
sentences.zh: 在第一次会面时，尼尔森就对莫斯产生了好感。

sentences.en: Moss found Nilsen to be calm and rational and agreed to accept him as a client
sentences.zh: 莫斯发现尼尔森冷静且理智，同意接受他作为客户。

sentences.en: The tabloid press had already been tipped off about the grim discovery at 23 Cranley Gardens
sentences.zh: 小报媒体已经收到了关于克兰利花园23号恐怖发现的风声，

sentences.en: by dino-rod plumber Mike Catron and were circling for further information so they could run a story
sentences.zh: 由Dino Rod公司的水管工迈克·卡特隆泄露，他们正四处打听更多信息以便抢发报道。

sentences.en: Within an hour of the formal charge being made, reporters managed to locate Nilsen's mother
sentences.zh: 在正式指控提出后的一小时内，记者们就找到了尼尔森的母亲

sentences.en: Betty in Aberdeenshire, Scotland and requested photographs of her son
sentences.zh: 贝蒂，她住在苏格兰的阿伯丁郡，并索要她儿子的照片。

sentences.en: Betty obliged on the basis they would be returned to her But she later found out the photographs were sold for large sums of money And she never got them back
sentences.zh: 贝蒂答应了，条件是照片要还给她。但后来她发现照片被高价卖掉了，而且她再也没拿回来。

sentences.en: That evening, Nilsen's friend, Martin Hunter Craig, was watching television when a news report
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，尼尔森的朋友马丁·亨特·克雷格正在看电视，新闻报道

sentences.en: revealed that body parts had been discovered in the drains of an apartment building in Muswell Hill.
sentences.zh: 披露在马斯韦尔山的一栋公寓楼的排水管中发现了人体部位。

sentences.en: The name of the killer was withheld, but when the report showed an image of 23 Cranley Gardens,
sentences.zh: 凶手的名字没有公布，但当报道展示克兰利花园23号的画面时，

sentences.en: Martin realised that Nilsen must be responsible.
sentences.zh: 马丁意识到尼尔森一定是凶手。

sentences.en: He was shocked to think that he had been at the property just days earlier.
sentences.zh: 想到自己几天前还去过那里，他感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: By Saturday February 12, the story was making headlines across England and overseas.
sentences.zh: 到2月12日星期六，这个故事已成为英国乃至海外的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Although the full extent of the murders hadn't yet been revealed, reporters had already dubbed the Muswell Hill property the House of Horrors and were referring
sentences.zh: 尽管谋杀案的全部规模尚未揭露，但记者们已经将马斯韦尔山的这处房产称为“恐怖之屋”，并称

sentences.en: to the killer as the Muswell Hill murderer.
sentences.zh: 凶手为“马斯韦尔山杀手”。

sentences.en: Police were still working around the clock to identify the remaining victims and had released very minor details to the media,
sentences.zh: 警方仍在夜以继日地确认其余受害者的身份，并向媒体发布了极少量的细节，

sentences.en: but journalists were working overtime in an attempt to get the best scoop.
sentences.zh: 但记者们为了抢到独家新闻正在加班加点。

sentences.en: Members of the press surrounded the Hornsey Police Station, with some attempting to rig a microphone outside of DCIJ's first floor window to obtain inside information.
sentences.zh: 媒体成员包围了霍恩西警察局，一些人试图在杰伊总督察二楼窗外安装麦克风以获取内部消息。

sentences.en: A Japanese news crew even positioned themselves in a house opposite the station and used highly sophisticated sound equipment to try to eavesdrop on police interviews with Nilsen.
sentences.zh: 一个日本新闻摄制组甚至在警察局对面的一栋房子里架设了设备，使用高精尖的录音器材试图窃听警方对尼尔森的审讯。

sentences.en: At 10am,
sentences.zh: 上午10点，

sentences.en: Nilsen made his first appearance in the magistrate's court, where the judge ruled that he be remanded
sentences.zh: 尼尔森首次在治安法庭出庭，法官裁定将他继续

sentences.en: in custody for three more days of questioning before further legal proceedings.
sentences.zh: 拘留三天进行审讯，然后再进行进一步的法律程序。

sentences.en: Afterwards, when he was being escorted out of the courthouse and back to the waiting police car,
sentences.zh: 事后，当他被押送出法院回到等候的警车时，

sentences.en: Nilsen elected to walk out in full view of the press.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森选择在媒体的众目睽睽之下走出来。

sentences.en: He later explained that he didn't want to hide away by covering his face like a common criminal.
sentences.zh: 他后来解释说，他不想像普通罪犯那样遮住脸躲躲闪闪。

sentences.en: Nilsen's mother participated in a television interview in which she stated,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的母亲接受了电视采访，她在采访中说：

sentences.en: I just don't understand how this could go on and nobody knowing anything.
sentences.zh: 我实在不明白这种事怎么会发生，而竟然没人知道。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know anything about the last 10 years of his life and I can't see what was happening to him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我对他过去10年的生活一无所知，也看不出他身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: Something must have happened to him, because it's not my dentist that's doing it, not the boy I knew that's doing these things.
sentences.zh: 他一定经历了什么，因为这不可能是我的儿子做的，这不是我认识的那个男孩会做出的事。

sentences.en: He's always my son and that's why I want him to know we're all concerned about him.
sentences.zh: 他永远是我的儿子，这就是为什么我想让他知道我们都很关心他。

sentences.en: And I just hope he'll get some help to cope with the situation he's in.
sentences.zh: 我只希望他能得到一些帮助，来应对他现在的处境。

sentences.en: The police continued to question Nilsen, with detectives consciously trying to maintain a relaxed atmosphere in order to keep him talking.
sentences.zh: 警方继续审讯尼尔森，侦探们有意识地试图保持轻松的氛围，以便让他继续开口。

sentences.en: Although they were horrified and occasionally physically sick from the details he divulged, they feared that he would clam up if he felt he was under attack.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们对尼尔森透露的细节感到恐惧，有时甚至生理性呕吐，但他们担心如果让他感到被攻击，他会闭口不谈。

sentences.en: Nilsen was unusually cooperative, offering details about each murder, descriptions of the techniques he used, and helping to identify the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森异常配合，主动提供每起谋杀案的细节、他所用手段的描述，并帮助确认受害者身份。

sentences.en: As author Brian Masters described in his book Killing for Company, quote,
sentences.zh: 正如作家布莱恩·马斯特斯在他的书《为伴而杀》中所描述的那样，引用：

sentences.en: Not only did Nilsen make no hindrance, but he positively swamped the detectives with information faster than they could seek it.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森不仅没有阻碍，反而主动向侦探们倾倒信息，速度快到他们都来不及追问。

sentences.en: He barely required questioning.
sentences.zh: 他几乎不需要审讯。

sentences.en: He spoke in an almost unbroken autobiographical monologue, as if to purge his conscience of a burden which he could no longer bear alone.
sentences.zh: 他几乎是在进行一场不间断的自传式独白，仿佛是为了洗清他内心再也无法独自承受的重负。

sentences.en: Yet, there were no irrelevant details, no digressions into personal life, no pleas for comfort or understanding.
sentences.zh: 然而，其中没有无关紧要的细节，没有偏离主题的个人生活叙述，也没有寻求安慰或理解的恳求。

sentences.en: He admitted that he was astonished he had no tears for the people who had died at his hands.
sentences.zh: 他承认，令他惊讶的是，对于死在他手里的人，他竟然流不出一滴眼泪。

sentences.en: It soon became clear to the detectives that the number of people who visited Nilsen's flat without incident far outweighed those who came under attack or were killed.
sentences.zh: 侦探们很快发现，去过尼尔森公寓且平安无事的人，远多于那些遭到攻击或被杀害的人。

sentences.en: Nilsen rejected the suggestion that he intentionally sought out victims, claiming that he only ever went out in search of company and the attacks were never planned.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森否认他是有意寻找受害者，声称他出门只是为了寻找陪伴，攻击从未经过预谋。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: When I voluntarily go out to drink, I do not have the intention at that time to do these things.
sentences.zh: 当我自愿出去喝酒时，我当时并没有做这些事的意图。

sentences.en: I seek company first and hope everything will be alright.
sentences.zh: 我首先寻求的是陪伴，并希望一切都会好起来。

sentences.en: Nilsen claimed to be relieved that he'd finally been caught, as he would have kept killing otherwise,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森声称，最终被抓让他感到解脱，否则他会一直杀下去，

sentences.en: and the detectives were convinced he never would have given himself up of his own accord.
sentences.zh: 而侦探们确信，如果不是被抓，他绝不会自首。

sentences.en: In a later interview for the television program Britain's Most Evil Serial Killers, DCIJ recalled,
sentences.zh: 在后来为电视节目《英国最邪恶的连环杀手》接受采访时，杰伊总督察回忆道：

sentences.en: Nilsen said, if you hadn't have caught me now, it wouldn't have been 15, it would have been 150.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森说，如果你们现在没抓到我，那就不止是15个，而是150个了。

sentences.en: And I think he might have been right.
sentences.zh: 我想他说得可能是对的。

sentences.en: When the formal interviews were finally complete, Nilsen's solicitor, Ronald Moss, asked him why he had committed the crimes.
sentences.zh: 当正式审讯最终结束时，尼尔森的律师罗纳德·莫斯问他为什么要犯罪。

sentences.en: Nilsen responded, quote,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森回答，引用：

sentences.en: I am hoping you will tell me that.
sentences.zh: 我正希望你能告诉我答案。

sentences.en: While the police and prosecution continued to gather evidence for trial, Nilsen was housed at Brixton Prison in the inner south of London.
sentences.zh: 在警方和检方继续为审判收集证据期间，尼尔森被关押在伦敦内南部的布里克斯顿监狱。

sentences.en: Upon his arrival, he was required to change into the standard prison-issued uniform of brown trousers and a blue-striped shirt, and based
sentences.zh: 他一到那里，就被要求换上标准的监狱制服——棕色裤子和蓝条纹衬衫。根据

sentences.en: on a psychiatrist's recommendation, he was placed in the prison's hospital wing for his own safety.
sentences.zh: 精神科医生的建议，为了他自己的安全，他被安置在监狱的医院区。

sentences.en: Nilsen was only allowed out of his cell to participate in supervised exercise for half an hour each day and was forbidden from associating with other prisoners.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森每天只被允许离开牢房参加半小时的监督锻炼，并被禁止与其他囚犯接触。

sentences.en: He was labelled a Category
sentences.zh: 他被列为A类

sentences.en: A prisoner, which meant he posed the highest threat to police and the public and was moved between cells every couple of days.
sentences.zh: 囚犯，这意味着他对警察和公众构成最高威胁，每隔几天就会被转移牢房。

sentences.en: Nilsen was also banned from attending the chapel, which upset him even though he was an atheiSt. Frustrated that the chaplains didn't stand up
sentences.zh: 尼尔森还被禁止去教堂，尽管他是无神论者，但这让他很不高兴。由于不满牧师们没有

sentences.en: to the prison governor on his behalf, he labelled them Christian hypocrites, who were worse than cockroaches.
sentences.zh: 代表他向监狱长抗争，他称他们为基督教伪君子，比蟑螂还不如。

sentences.en: With Nilsen incarcerated, his beloved dog Bleep was taken in by an animal rescue shelter in southwest London to be rehomed.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森入狱后，他心爱的狗Bleep被伦敦西南部的一家动物救援所收留，等待重新安置。

sentences.en: But within a week of her arrival, she became ill and passed away.
sentences.zh: 但它到达那里不到一周就病倒并去世了。

sentences.en: Her death left Nilsen heartbroken and he later explained to author Brian Masters, I am ashamed that her last days should be so painful.
sentences.zh: 它的死让尼尔森心碎，他后来向作家布莱恩·马斯特斯解释说：我为它最后的日子如此痛苦而感到羞愧。

sentences.en: She had always forgiven me everything and nothing but me could ever break her heart.
sentences.zh: 它总是原谅我的一切，除了我，没有什么能伤它的心。

sentences.en: She never let me down, but in the moment of her greatest crisis.
sentences.zh: 它从未让我失望，但在它最危急的时刻，

sentences.en: I was not there.
sentences.zh: 我却不在它身边。

sentences.en: In prison, Nilsen soon became infatuated with a fellow inmate named David Martin, a small, effeminate career criminal who had spent his whole life in and out of jail.
sentences.zh: 在狱中，尼尔森很快迷恋上了一名狱友，名叫戴维·马丁，一个瘦小、女性化的职业罪犯，一生都在进出监狱。

sentences.en: Martin was serving time for a spray of burglaries which resulted in him shooting a police officer and later escaping from the magistrate's court using pins he stored in his
sentences.zh: 马丁因一系列入室盗窃案入狱，期间他曾枪击一名警察，后来利用藏在

sentences.en: long hair.
sentences.zh: 长发里的发夹从治安法庭逃脱。

sentences.en: Nilsen and Martin barely spent any time together and only saw each other occasionally in
sentences.zh: 尼尔森和马丁几乎没有在一起的时间，只是偶尔在

sentences.en: the exercise yard, but Nilsen became upset when Martin was relocated to a different prison a few months later.
sentences.zh: 操场上见到，但几个月后马丁被转移到另一所监狱时，尼尔森感到非常难过。

sentences.en: In an attempt to maintain a semblance of a connection with Martin, Nilsen contacted Martin's solicitor Ralph Hyames to ask if he would consider representing him as a client.
sentences.zh: 为了维持与马丁的某种联系，尼尔森联系了马丁的律师拉尔夫·海姆斯，询问他是否愿意担任自己的辩护律师。

sentences.en: Hayim's had a reputation for successfully defending notorious clients So some also saw this as a tactical decision on Nilsen's behalf
sentences.zh: 海姆斯以成功为臭名昭著的客户辩护而闻名，所以有些人也认为这是尼尔森采取的一种策略。

sentences.en: He felt that his initial solicitor, Ronald Moss Was failing to help him stand up against the prison regime that he believed was working to bully him
sentences.zh: 他觉得他最初的律师罗纳德·莫斯没能帮他对抗他认为正在欺凌他的监狱制度，

sentences.en: And he had dismissed and rehired Moss three times
sentences.zh: 他已经解雇并重新聘用了莫斯三次。

sentences.en: During those periods where Nilsen had no legal representation, he had unsuccessfully attempted to represent himself
sentences.zh: 在尼尔森没有法律代表的那些时期，他曾尝试为自己辩护，但均告失败。

sentences.en: Hyames agreed to take Nilsen on as a client, but they soon butted heads
sentences.zh: 海姆斯同意接手尼尔森的案子，但他们很快就产生了分歧。

sentences.en: Nilsen accused Hyames of working too closely with the press, yet failing to use these opportunities to tell the public how poorly Nilsen was being treated in prison
sentences.zh: 尼尔森指责海姆斯与媒体走得太近，却没能利用这些机会告诉公众他在狱中受到了多么糟糕的对待。

sentences.en: Despite their disagreements, Hayems was able to convince Nilsen against pleading guilty to all
sentences.zh: 尽管有分歧，海姆斯还是成功说服尼尔森不要对所有

sentences.en: charges as he believed he could use the defence of diminished responsibility due to mental disorder.
sentences.zh: 指控认罪，因为他认为可以利用精神障碍导致的责任能力减弱作为辩护理由。

sentences.en: To pass the time in prison, Nilsen spent most of his days writing.
sentences.zh: 为了在狱中打发时间，尼尔森大部分时间都在写作。

sentences.en: He started working on an autobiographical manuscript titled History of a Drowning Boy and also established a professional
sentences.zh: 他开始着手撰写一本名为《溺水男孩的历史》的自传手稿，并与布莱恩·马斯特斯建立了一种职业

sentences.en: relationship with Brian Masters, an author best known for his histories of the British aristocracy.
sentences.zh: 关系，马斯特斯是一位以撰写英国贵族史而闻名的作家。

sentences.en: Masters had developed an interest in the extremities of human behaviour and wrote a letter to Nilsen asking if he would be open to cooperating on a book project.
sentences.zh: 马斯特斯对人类行为的极端表现产生了兴趣，并写信给尼尔森，询问他是否愿意合作完成一个图书项目。

sentences.en: On March 30 1983, Nilsen wrote to accept Masters' invitation, opening the letter by saying,
sentences.zh: 1983年3月30日，尼尔森写信接受了马斯特斯的邀请，信的开头写道：

sentences.en: The two began exchanging letters, with Masters also visiting Brixton Prison twice a week to speak with his subject.
sentences.zh: 两人开始互通书信，马斯特斯还每周两次前往布里克斯顿监狱与他的采访对象交谈。

sentences.en: Nilsen didn't hold back, providing a comprehensive and in-depth account of his childhood, his time in the army, career problems, sexual fantasies,
sentences.zh: 尼尔森毫无保留，对他自己的童年、军旅生涯、职业困境、性幻想、

sentences.en: relationship history and each of the murders.
sentences.zh: 感情经历以及每一桩谋杀案都做了详尽而深入的陈述。

sentences.en: In an early letter to Masters, Nilsen wrote,
sentences.zh: 在给马斯特斯的一封早期信件中，尼尔森写道：

sentences.en: I have led a strange life so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我过着一种奇怪的生活。

sentences.en: Schoolboy, soldier, chef, projectionist, policeman, clerical officer, executive officer, drunk, sexualist, male and female, murderer,
sentences.zh: 学生、士兵、厨师、放映员、警察、文职人员、行政官员、酒鬼、性癖者、男人和女人、杀人犯、

sentences.en: animal lover, independent trades union officer, debater, champion of social causes,
sentences.zh: 动物爱好者、独立工会官员、辩论者、社会事业的拥护者、

sentences.en: do-gooder, dissector of murder victims, grand vizier, and probably lifer.
sentences.zh: 慈善家、谋杀受害者的解剖者、大维齐尔，可能还是个终身监禁者。

sentences.en: If there is a God, he must have a weird and jumbled sense of priorities.
sentences.zh: 如果上帝存在，他一定有着一种古怪而混乱的优先事项感。

sentences.en: Job finder, peace campaigner, amateur filmmaker, mine of useless information, administrator, pen pusher, detained prisoner, solitary reaper,
sentences.zh: 求职者、和平运动者、业余电影制作人、无用信息的宝库、行政人员、文书官、被拘留的囚犯、孤独的收割者、

sentences.en: killer of the innocent, unremorseful, reformed character, enigma, now rapidly becoming a national
sentences.zh: 无辜者的杀手、毫无悔意者、改过自新者、谜一样的人，现在正迅速成为一个国家的

sentences.en: receptacle into which all the nation will urinate, warped monster, madman, ungodly, cold and alone.
sentences.zh: 容器，全国人民都会向里面撒尿，扭曲的怪物、疯子、亵渎者、寒冷而孤独。

sentences.en: Nilsen told masters about one incident in particular that had a profound impact on his life.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森向马斯特斯讲述了一件对他人生影响深远的特殊事件。

sentences.en: In 1967, when he was stationed at Al-Mansoura Detention Centre in Yemen, he had been drinking heavily in town and hailed a taxi to take him back to the base.
sentences.zh: 1967年，当他驻扎在也门的曼苏拉拘留中心时，他在城里喝得酩酊大醉，于是叫了一辆出租车送他回基地。

sentences.en: During the drive, he dozed off in the back seat and later woke with a sharp pain in the back of his head.
sentences.zh: 车开动时，他在后座睡着了，后来被后脑勺的一阵剧痛惊醒。

sentences.en: He realised he was naked and had been struck over the head and placed into the boot of the car.
sentences.zh: 他意识到自己赤身裸体，头部遭到重击，并被塞进了汽车后备箱。

sentences.en: Nilsen attempted to break free from the vehicle, which was still being driven, but was unable to open the boot.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森试图从仍在行驶的车辆中挣脱出来，但无法打开后备箱。

sentences.en: After a short drive, the car stopped and Nilsen decided that his best chance to escape would be to play dead.
sentences.zh: 行驶了一小段路后，车停了下来，尼尔森认为他逃生的最佳机会就是装死。

sentences.en: The taxi driver got out, opened the boot and started touching Nilsen, who tried to look as limp and lifeless as possible.
sentences.zh: 出租车司机下车打开后备箱，开始触碰尼尔森，尼尔森尽量让自己看起来瘫软无力。

sentences.en: The driver attempted to lift Nilsen out, at which point Nilsen's hand touched metal and he realised there was a carjack handle close to him.
sentences.zh: 司机试图把尼尔森抬出来，就在这时，尼尔森的手碰到了金属，他意识到身边有一个千斤顶手柄。

sentences.en: He grabbed hold of it and delivered a hard blow to the taxi driver's head, immediately knocking him unconscious.
sentences.zh: 他抓住手柄，狠狠地砸向出租车司机的头部，瞬间将其击昏。

sentences.en: Nilsen climbed out of the boot and struck the driver twice more in the skull.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森爬出后备箱，又对着司机的头骨猛击了两下。

sentences.en: He saw that the car was parked in an isolated spot amidst the cluster of old buildings, so he wiped the jackhandle clean and put it back in the boot along with the driver.
sentences.zh: 他看到车停在一处旧建筑群中的偏僻地带，于是擦干净千斤顶手柄，把它和司机一起放回了后备箱。

sentences.en: Then he quickly put his clothes on and walked to the detention centre through the darkness.
sentences.zh: 然后他迅速穿上衣服，在黑暗中步行回到了拘留中心。

sentences.en: He was reprimanded for being delinquent but never said a word to anyone about his ordeal.
sentences.zh: 他因玩忽职守受到训斥，但对自己的这段经历只字未提。

sentences.en: Nilsen told Masters that the next morning he was filled with horror over the incident and started having nightmares about being tortured, raped, murdered and mutilated.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森告诉马斯特斯，第二天他被这件事吓坏了，开始做噩梦，梦见自己被折磨、强奸、谋杀和肢解。

sentences.en: A psychologist later determined that Nilsen had fabricated this entire event.
sentences.zh: 一位心理学家后来认定，尼尔森编造了整个事件。

sentences.en: If that was the case, Masters believed that further proved just how powerful Nilsen's fantasies were.
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，马斯特斯认为这进一步证明了尼尔森的幻想有多么强大。

sentences.en: However, if the incident was true, Masters has pointed out that it demonstrated how successfully Nilsen was able to compartmentalise a horrific memory while outwardly appearing
sentences.zh: 然而，如果这件事是真的，马斯特斯指出，这证明了尼尔森能够多么成功地将恐怖的记忆隔离开来，同时外表看起来

sentences.en: unaffected.
sentences.zh: 若无其事。

sentences.en: Investigators continued the difficult task of identifying Nilsen's victiMs.
sentences.zh: 调查人员继续着识别尼尔森受害者的艰巨任务。

sentences.en: Other than the human remains found at the Muswell Hill Flat, there was little physical
sentences.zh: 除了在马斯韦尔山公寓发现的人类遗骸外，几乎没有什么实物

sentences.en: evidence to go on, so they had to rely on Nilsen's recollections and missing person reports to join the dots.
sentences.zh: 证据可供参考，因此他们不得不依靠尼尔森的回忆和失踪人口报告来串联线索。

sentences.en: An operation room was set up and decked out with bulletin boards and blackboards, as well as poster-sized pieces of paper dedicated to each victim.
sentences.zh: 他们设立了一个行动室，挂满了公告板和黑板，还有为每位受害者准备的海报大小的纸张。

sentences.en: On each poster, investigators listed as many details about the individual as possible, including their physical description, last known
sentences.zh: 在每张海报上，调查人员列出了尽可能多的个人细节，包括他们的外貌特征、最后已知的

sentences.en: whereabouts, the date they were last seen, and the date Nilsen claimed they were murdered.
sentences.zh: 下落、最后一次露面的日期，以及尼尔森声称他们被谋杀的日期。

sentences.en: In addition to Stephen Sinclair, police were eventually able to identify a total of seven
sentences.zh: 除了斯蒂芬·辛克莱，警方最终总共确认了另外七名

sentences.en: other victiMs. The 28-year-old who Nilsen knew only as John the Guardsman was identified during
sentences.zh: 受害者。那位尼尔森只知道叫“卫兵约翰”的28岁男子，是在

sentences.en: a painstaking process in which police located every man with the name of John in the local area.
sentences.zh: 一个艰苦的过程中被确认身份的，警方在当地找到了所有名叫约翰的男子。

sentences.en: Using a strip of muscle retrieved from Nilsen's flat, they determined the victim's blood type and used this to narrow down the list of unaccounted for Johns that matched the
sentences.zh: 利用从尼尔森公寓中提取的一块肌肉组织，他们确定了受害者的血型，并以此缩小了未查明的约翰名单，这些约翰符合

sentences.en: description Nilsen provided, finally identifying him as John Howlett.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森提供的描述，最终确认他就是约翰·豪利特。

sentences.en: Martin Duffy, the 16-year-old catering student who Nilsen murdered in his Melrose Avenue flat,
sentences.zh: 马丁·达菲，那位尼尔森在梅尔罗斯大道公寓中谋杀的16岁餐饮专业学生，

sentences.en: was identified using the chef's knives that Nilsen had kept, which had Martin's name engraved on them.
sentences.zh: 是通过尼尔森保留的厨师刀具确认身份的，刀上刻有马丁的名字。

sentences.en: Kenneth Ockenden, the 23-year-old tourist who Nilsen had killed just days before his expected
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯·奥肯登，那位尼尔森在预期返回加拿大前几天杀害的23岁游客，

sentences.en: return to Canada, was identified when Nilsen was shown a photograph and recognised the young man.
sentences.zh: 是在尼尔森看到一张照片并认出这名年轻人时被确认身份的。

sentences.en: Kenneth's London street directory was found amongst Nilsen's belongings, and forensic investigators were able to locate a partial fingerprint and match it against prints
sentences.zh: 肯尼斯的伦敦街道指南在他人的遗物中被发现，法医调查员成功提取了一枚部分指纹，并将其与肯尼斯留在酒店房间里的

sentences.en: recovered from the belongings Kenneth had left behind in his hotel room.
sentences.zh: 遗物上的指纹进行了比对。

sentences.en: The family of 26-year-old
sentences.zh: 26岁的比利·萨瑟兰的家人，

sentences.en: Billy Sutherland, who had reported him missing in 1980, contacted police after seeing news about the murders and wondering whether Billy could have been a victim.
sentences.zh: 曾在1980年报告他失踪，在看到关于谋杀案的新闻后联系了警方，想知道比利是否可能是受害者之一。

sentences.en: Nilsen was shown a photograph of Billy and recognised him as one of the men he had killed in his Melrose Avenue flat.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森被展示了比利的照片，并认出他就是自己在梅尔罗斯大道公寓杀害的男子之一。

sentences.en: Human remains were found under the floorboards in Nilsen's old flat and forensic investigators
sentences.zh: 在尼尔森旧公寓的地板下发现了人类遗骸，法医调查员

sentences.en: were able to confirm Billy's identity from false teeth and a piece of skin with one of his tattoos on it.
sentences.zh: 通过假牙和一块带有纹身的皮肤碎片确认了比利的身份。

sentences.en: Also identified was 24-year-old Malcolm Barlow, who Nilsen strangled in his Melrose
sentences.zh: 同样被确认身份的还有24岁的马尔科姆·巴洛，尼尔森在马尔科姆出院后的第二天，

sentences.en: Avenue flat the day after Malcolm was discharged from hospital.
sentences.zh: 在梅尔罗斯大道的公寓里将他勒死。

sentences.en: Paul Nobbs, the 19-year-old university student who Nilsen attempted to strangle in his sleep soon after moving into
sentences.zh: 保罗·诺布斯，那位尼尔森在搬进克兰利花园公寓后不久，试图在他睡梦中勒死的19岁大学生，

sentences.en: the Cranley Gardens flat, was identified as a survivor, as was 26-year-old Scotsman Douglas
sentences.zh: 被确认为幸存者，同样被确认的还有26岁的苏格兰人道格拉斯·斯图尔特，

sentences.en: Stewart, who had fought off an attack at Melrose Avenue on November 10, 1980.
sentences.zh: 他在1980年11月10日于梅尔罗斯大道击退了一次袭击。

sentences.en: Nilsen's committal hearing commenced in the Old Bailey, the Central Criminal Court of England and Wales.
sentences.zh: 尼尔森的交付审判在老贝利法院（英格兰和威尔士的中央刑事法院）开始。

sentences.en: The judge determined the prosecution had enough evidence to put Nilsen to trial for the murders of Stephen Sinclair, John Howlett, Billy Sutherland, Martin Duffy, Kenneth Ockenden
sentences.zh: 法官认定检方有足够的证据将尼尔森送上法庭，指控他谋杀斯蒂芬·辛克莱、约翰·豪利特、比利·萨瑟兰、马丁·达菲、肯尼斯·奥肯登

sentences.en: and Malcolm Barlow, and for the attempted murders of Paul Nobbs and Douglas Stewart.
sentences.zh: 和马尔科姆·巴洛，并指控他谋杀未遂保罗·诺布斯和道格拉斯·斯图尔特。

sentences.en: it.
sentences.zh: 它。

sentences.en: The trial was scheduled to commence in October 1983.
sentences.zh: 审判定于1983年10月开始。

sentences.en: From the beginning of Nilsen's time in custody, he was required to wear the standard issue prison uniform.
sentences.zh: 从尼尔森被拘留开始，他就被要求穿上标准的监狱制服。

sentences.en: This enraged him as he hadn't yet been convicted of a crime.
sentences.zh: 这让他非常愤怒，因为他当时还没有被判有罪。

sentences.en: He protested against it by walking around his cell naked.
sentences.zh: 他通过在牢房里裸体走动来抗议。

sentences.en: In response, the guards restricted him from leaving his cell entirely, which meant he was unable to empty his toilet bucket.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，狱警完全限制他离开牢房，这意味着他无法倒掉他的马桶桶。

sentences.en: On August 1, when Nilsen's bucket was full to the brim, he yelled, stand clear, and proceeded to throw its contents through the bars of his cell and onto the landing.
sentences.zh: 8月1日，当尼尔森的桶装满时，他大喊“闪开”，随后将桶里的东西通过牢房的栅栏扔到了走廊上。

sentences.en: Several guards were hit with the mess, and Nilsen was beaten in retaliation and given 56 days in solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 几名狱警被弄脏了，尼尔森因此遭到报复性殴打，并被单独监禁了56天。

sentences.en: As Nilsen's time on remand went by, he began to express regret for committing the crimes.
sentences.zh: 随着尼尔森在还押期间的时间流逝，他开始对犯下的罪行表示遗憾。

sentences.en: In a letter he sent to detectives thanking them for their professionalism when unravelling the case, Nilsen wrote,
sentences.zh: 在写给侦探的一封信中，他感谢他们在破案过程中的专业精神，尼尔森写道：

sentences.en: My remorse is of a deep and personal kind which will lead away inside me for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 我的悔恨是一种深刻而个人的情感，它将在我的余生中一直伴随着我。

sentences.en: I am a tragically private person, not given to public tears
sentences.zh: 我是一个悲剧性的内向者，不习惯在公众面前流泪。

sentences.en: The enormity of these acts has left me in permanent shock
sentences.zh: 这些行为的严重性让我陷入了永久的震惊之中。

sentences.en: The evil was short-lived and it cannot live or breathe for long inside the conscience I have slain my own dragon, as surely as the press and the letter of the law will slay me
sentences.zh: 邪恶是短暂的，它无法在我杀死了自己心魔的良心中长久存活或呼吸，正如媒体和法律条文终将杀死我一样。

sentences.zh: 下周继续
